name: Will Kenrith
description: Will Kenrith is an ice-mage planeswalker from Eldraine, twin brother of Rowan, who became acting king and then High King of Eldraine and lost his spark in the Desparkening.

description_citations.text: "Will Kenrith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

summary.text: Will Kenrith is an ice-mage planeswalker from Eldraine, twin brother of Rowan, who became acting king and then High King of Eldraine and lost his spark in the Desparkening.

citations.text: "Will Kenrith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Eldraine". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Will and Rowan were born to a witch who killed newborns for their blood, and their adoptive mother Linden gave up her sword's power to restore them.

citations.text: "Will Kenrith", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Linden Kenrith", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: The twins quested to save their abducted father, and Will rescued the cursed Garruk, whose curse the Cauldron of Eternity lifted.

citations.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Restoration of the High King", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: Learning the truth about their origins ignited their shared planeswalker spark and they planeswalked away.

citations.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Rowan Kenrith". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

bio.text: At Strixhaven the twins fought the Oriq, and Will cast a control spell on the Blood Avatar that, with Rowan's power, brought it down, though the Avatar's sword took his lower right leg.

citations.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.
Culmination of Studies (Strixhaven: School of Mages Promos, 2021), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
"Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

bio.text: After the Phyrexian invasion the twins unknowingly lost their shared spark as the Wicked Slumber seized Eldraine, and Will took his father's crown as High King.

citations.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Eldraine", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

bio.text: He challenged Imodane to a duel, won her fealty, and clashed with Rowan, who left to find a cure for the Wicked Slumber.

citations.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citations.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.
"Imodane", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citations.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart
citations.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 1: Pure of Heart" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 8 Aug 2023.

bio.text: He assaulted Castle Ardenvale, struck Ashiok with ice and captured Eriette, ending the Wicked Slumber, while Rowan escaped into the Wilds.

citations.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

citations.work: Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths
citations.text: "Wilds of Eldraine | Episode 5: Broken Oaths" by K. Arsenault Rivera. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Aug 2023.

status.text: Will is alive and rules Eldraine as High King, and he is described as a former planeswalker who lost his spark in the Desparkening.

citations.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wicked Slumber". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
"Will Kenrith". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will asks if the plan will work and Rowan says it will be spectacular if it does.
timeline.quote: "No," said Rowan. "But if it does, it's going to be spectacular."

citation.text: Huddle Up (Battlebond, 2018), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Rowan and Will wonder whether a stag in a vision can lead them to their father.
timeline.quote: Could the stag in the vision lead them to their father?

citation.text: Unexplained Vision (Throne of Eldraine, 2019), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The royal twins find their father but their shared planeswalker spark ignites and sends them across the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: the Kenrith twins' shared Planeswalker's spark ignited, sending them across the Blind Eternities to a new plane.

citation.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will moves rule to Castle Vantress, Eriette claims Ardenvale, and she is eventually deposed and captured by Will.
timeline.quote: She was eventually deposed and captured by Will.

citation.text: "Ardenvale", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The royal twins set out at eighteen to find their father.
timeline.quote: When the royal twins turned eighteen, they set out on a quest to find their father.

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Algenus is returned to life with his magical sword, and the twins' planeswalker spark ignites, sending them to a new plane.
timeline.quote: Learning the truth of their past, the Kenrith twins' shared Planeswalker's spark ignited, sending them across the Blind Eternities to a new plane.

citation.text: "Eldraine", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Oko's behest Garruk saves the Kenrith twins from Redcaps and kills the High King's guards before Oko kidnaps the king.
timeline.quote: Garruk killed the guards of the High King at Oko's behest

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk guards the prisoners while Oko prepares to have the High King killed as a stag.
timeline.quote: he was left to guard the prisoners

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will removes the hedron from Garruk; the curse runs wild and Garruk rampages, injuring Cerise and killing Cado's corrupted griffin.
timeline.quote: As the hedron was removed from Garruk, the curse ran wild, driving him into a frenzy.

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk falls into the river and sinks; Will dives in to save him and pulls him into a chalice.
timeline.quote: Will barely reached the surface, pulling the man into the large chalice

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The chalice pulls the curse from Garruk and gives him life; he carries Will to shore.
timeline.quote: the chalice had forcibly pulled the curse from his form

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk follows the twins to Kylem and leaves them alone once they are safe.
timeline.quote: Garruk followed Rowan and Will to Kylem .

citation.text: "Garruk", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rowan and Will are born to a witch who kills the newborns for their blood; Linden gives up her sword's power to restore them and adopts them.
timeline.quote: their adoptive mother gave up her sword's power to restore life to the twins and took them in as her children

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The twins quest for their father, abducted by Oko and Garruk and transformed into a stag.
timeline.quote: he has been transformed into a stag

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Learning the truth about their origins ignites the twins' spark and they planeswalk away.
timeline.quote: The shock ignites the twins' planeswalker's spark and they disappear.

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The twins compete as champions of Valor's Reach on Kylem.
timeline.quote: The twins were champions of Valor's Reach .

citation.text: "Rowan Kenrith", section "Kylem". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The twins Rowan and Will Kenrith embark on a quest to save their father.
timeline.quote: embark on a quest to save their father

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The king is saved, Garruk is freed from his curse, and the twins' spark ignites.
timeline.quote: In the end, the king is saved, Garruk is freed from his curse, and the twins' Planeswalker's spark ignites .

citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko and Garruk rescue the twins from redcaps in the Wilds.
timeline.quote: they are unexpectedly rescued by Oko and Garruk.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Harvest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko disguises himself as Cado and wipes the twins' memory of their encounter.
timeline.quote: He disguises himself as Cado and deletes the memory of their encounter in the twin's minds.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Harvest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Three months later Rowan and Will decide to quest for their father, joined by Titus and Cerise.
timeline.quote: Rowan and Will decide to start on a quest to find their father, and Titus and Cerise join them.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Cerise removes the hedron from Garruk, freeing his will but unleashing the Chain Veil's curse.
timeline.quote: While this has the desired effect of Garruk regaining his memories and his own will, it also returns the Chain Veil 's curse to its full force.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will's persistence summons the Cauldron of Eternity, which lifts Garruk's curse.
timeline.quote: Will's act of persistence summons the Cauldron of Eternity .

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Linden uses the sword's life to return Algenus to the living; Rowan's spark ignites and she and Will vanish.
timeline.quote: As there is still life in Algenus' sword from the well, Linden uses it to return him to the world of the living.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Garruk pledges to find and protect the twins.
timeline.quote: Garruk pledges to find them and protect them.

citation.work: Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest
citation.text: "Throne of Eldraine: The Wildered Quest", section "Winter". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Indrelon is stolen and moved to Stormkeld; Will Kenrith abandons Ardenvale for Vantress and has wizards encase Wicked Slumber victims in glass caskets.
timeline.quote: Indrelon was stolen from Castle Vantress and moved to Beluna Grandsquall 's castle, Stormkeld.

citation.text: "Vantress", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan are born to a witch who kills the newborns for their blood; their adoptive mother restores them and raises them.
timeline.quote: Their birth mother killed the newborns for their blood, which she would have drunk to extend her life.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "Youth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will has a vision in the ice at seventeen.
timeline.quote: At seventeen, Will experienced a vision in a sheet of ice.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The vision". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The twins quest for their abducted father; Will rescues Garruk, summoning the Cauldron of Eternity which cures him.
timeline.quote: Later on, Will rescues Garruk from certain death.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The twins fail to protect the stag from the Wild Hunt; Linden restores the High King.
timeline.quote: bringing Algenus back to life by using his Questing Sword.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The shock of learning their origins ignites the twins' spark and they disappear.
timeline.quote: The shock ignites the twins' planeswalker's spark and they disappear.

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The twins compete as champions of Valor's Reach on Kylem.
timeline.quote: The twins were champions of Valor's Reach .

citation.text: "Will Kenrith", section "Kylem". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Will, unable to choose which books to bring, prepares to leave Kylem for Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: Will Kenrith stared helplessly at the towering stack of books on his bed.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Will recalls that Kasmina's invitation came soon after Garruk left them on their own.
timeline.quote: her invitation had come out of nowhere, arriving only a few days after Garruk had been satisfied enough in their security to leave them on their own

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan opens a portal and steps through, and Will is pulled after her.
timeline.quote: Rowan grinned and waved as she stepped into the light and disappeared.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The twins arrive on Arcavios where Kasmina and her owl greet them.
timeline.quote: I see you've both made it.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: They pass a huge silver torch on the road to the school.
timeline.quote: The silver column rose high above the trees, piercing the brilliant blue sky.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina welcomes them to Strixhaven as they crest a ridge over the campus.
timeline.quote: Welcome to Strixhaven.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Kasmina leaves them at the gates, telling them to find Mavinda Sharpbeak.
timeline.quote: Look for an owlin called Mavinda Sharpbeak.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: The twins find Prismari and Silverquill students dueling in a courtyard.
timeline.quote: two groups of students flung spells across a grassy field

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Will's ruined Memoirs of Thadus pushes him to join the fight alongside Rowan.
timeline.quote: Maybe it is our fight.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan combine ice and lightning, but the spells fail to blend smoothly.
timeline.quote: Something wasn't right.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Liliana notices the twins mention Kylem and wonders if they are planeswalkers who could be useful.
timeline.quote: They probably weren't Oriq agents.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: In their dorm, Will says their combined magic failed and wonders whether the plane affects it.
timeline.quote: it should have been smoother. More cohesive.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan leaves to live her own life, and Will resolves to find answers alone.
timeline.quote: We may be twins, but I'm allowed to live my own life.

citation.text: "Episode 1: Class Is in Session" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Mar 2021.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan argue about her lack of study, and lightning sparks from her hair when she gets angry.
timeline.quote: it was the coils of electricity jumping between loose strands of hair on his sister's face

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Quint spills tea on ancient books and fixes it with a like-to-like spell.
timeline.quote: The spilled tea began to rise, small droplets floating from the page to fall back into Quint's cup.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will confronts Rowan at Bow's End about barely passing Professor Onyx's exam.
timeline.quote: You barely passed, Rowan

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will invokes their birth mother, and Rowan's anger crackles through the air.
timeline.quote: Will could feel the hair on his arms stand up as an electric charge coursed through the air around him.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan leaves with her Witherbloom friends, telling Will to leave her alone.
timeline.quote: Leave me alone, Will. You can't tell me what to do.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The twins stop speaking for weeks until the Mage Tower match.
timeline.quote: he hadn't spoken to her in weeks

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: A Prismari player hypnotizes the Silverquill mascot into biting its holder and steals it in the Mage Tower match.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, it leaned over and sunk two long liquid fangs into the Silverquill player's hand.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will provokes Rowan in the stands, and she shocks him with lightning.
timeline.quote: Will felt the spark jump from her outstretched hand and pass through his whole body in an instant.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will freezes Rowan's boots and hand with his ice magic.
timeline.quote: Rowan gasped as a rime of frost suddenly solidified around her boots, freezing her feet in place.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx stops the fight and takes the twins to her office.
timeline.quote: He squinted as he looked up, meeting Professor Onyx's gaze.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx warns the twins about the Oriq and hints Strixhaven does not hold all power on the plane, leaving Will suspecting she is a planeswalker.
timeline.quote: Strixhaven doesn't have a monopoly on power in this plane.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will wants to prepare to defend the students, while Rowan says she will prepare her own way.
timeline.quote: I'll prepare my own way for whatever's coming.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan siphons power from a water elemental in the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: Electricity crackled and leapt across her fingers as she pulled the veins of power out of its watery surface, toward her.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan tells Will she has learned that breaking the rules gets things done and leaves him.
timeline.quote: I learned that when you're not afraid to break the rules, you can get a whole lot done.

citation.text: "Episode 3: Extracurriculars" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will wakes to learn from Wickel that the Oriq are attacking.
timeline.quote: The Oriq are here

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Wickel raises a wall of earth to hold back mage hunters while students flee.
timeline.quote: A semicircle of churning soil rippled out from where he stood, rising up into a wall of dense earth between the creatures and the students.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will freezes dew to trip a mage hunter and drains heat from another's shell.
timeline.quote: Behind him, the evening dew condensed into hard ice.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The dragons arrive and burn the mage hunters to ash with columns of fire.
timeline.quote: A column of fire shot down from the sky and swept over the ground.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will and Rowan reunite and hug.
timeline.quote: They ran toward each other and fell into a hug, squeezing each other tightly.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Professor Onyx kills an Oriq agent aiming at the twins.
timeline.quote: When she opened them, she saw the Oriq splayed across the ground.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Onyx tells them the mage hunters have formed a perimeter around the Biblioplex.
timeline.quote: They've formed a perimeter around the Biblioplex.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Onyx admits she is not a responsible professor and recruits the twins to help her.
timeline.quote: No. I'm not quite so responsible as that. And I need help.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Onyx opens an old maintenance passage she found as a student.
timeline.quote: It's an old maintenance passage I found when I was a student.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will saves Rowan from falling through a rotting bridge.
timeline.quote: Will dove as Rowan fell, locking one hand around her wrist.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Onyx reveals she is leading them to where the most damage could be done.
timeline.quote: I'm taking you where I would go, if I wanted to cause the most damage possible.

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The twins zap and ice-bind Oriq agents as Liliana leads them to the Snarl.
timeline.quote: at the first sign of one of the masked Oriq, Rowan would zap them with a current of energy that left them twitching on the ground

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Extus freezes and shatters Rowan's lightning and breaks Will's ice shield.
timeline.quote: shattering on the ground as if made of glass

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan proposes to draw power from the Snarl, but Will says it is too dangerous.
timeline.quote: That's too dangerous!

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The four-armed Blood Avatar rises from the blood fountain in a bronze helmet.
timeline.quote: In each of its four muscular arms, it clutched a cruel weapon

citation.text: "Episode 4: Put to the Test" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 14 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will's ice shards at Extus are blown apart by Rowan's lightning.
timeline.quote: a bolt of lightning cracked through the shards, detonating them

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rubble knocks Will down, and Rowan fails to hurt the Blood Avatar's sword.
timeline.quote: The monster only pulled its sword free, throwing her backward.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The twins apologize to each other for their fights.
timeline.quote: I'm sorry about the fight.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will realizes the Blood Avatar can be controlled like the Mage Tower mascot.
timeline.quote: It's like a mascot!

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Will casts a red halo control spell on the Blood Avatar's head.
timeline.quote: Suddenly, a red halo of light snapped into place around the Blood Avatar's helmed head.

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: Rowan pours her last magical energy into Will, completing the spell.
timeline.quote: Rowan poured the last of her magical energy into her brother

citation.text: "Episode 5: Final Exam" by Adana Washington. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Apr 2021.

timeline.summary: The spell breaks and the Blood Avatar's sword takes Will's lower right leg as it is pulled back into the Snarl.
